tables.name: Market Day
tables.description: Extra Intrigue. Something special on market day. Roll more than once for several, or reuse the table for later market days.

results.name: Monkey Merchant
results.description: A merchant selling lively, little monkeys has arrived, and whipped both the local, and visiting, children into an excited frenzy.

results.name: Downpour
results.description: It’s raining. Hard. Many of the vendors are fighting to get their wares covered so they remain unspoiled.

results.name: Half-Price Produce
results.description: Fruits and vegetables have been in easy supply recently, so are being sold at half the usual price.

results.name: Loose Cattle
results.description: A cattle merchant’s pen has broken, and cows now roam all over town. The merchant is trying their best to round them up.

results.name: Stall Fire
results.description: A cookfire has sparked a blaze, setting one of the stalls alight, and is now threatening to spread to neighboring tables.

results.name: Puppet Show
results.description: A traveling puppet show is in town, performing a political parody of some famous regional figures to rapturous applause.

results.name: Bandit Merchants
results.description: Bandits, posing as merchants, are stealing goods from the other, legitimate merchants nearby.

results.name: Apple Thief
results.description: A small child has swiped an apple from a fruit cart. The merchant has noticed, and is yelling after the small, fleeing figure, calling for someone to catch them.

results.name: Wedding Reception
results.description: A local wedding is taking place in town, and the reception is being set up alongside the merchants in the square, supplementing all the hubbub with happy music and dancing.

results.name: Tavern Special
results.description: One of the taverns, facing onto the market square, has announced a market day special, and now has an ever-growing line out their door.

results.name: Injured Guard
results.description: An injured guard has ridden into the marketplace, looking around frantically. They have promptly passed out, falling from their horse.

results.name: Infested Cargo
results.description: One of the merchants’ wagon loads is infested with some kind of pest, and the guards are working to remove the cart and its cargo to be burnt outside of town, before it spreads. The merchant is arguing loudly and desperately.
